# VerifiedMargins

> VerifiedMargins is a public seller-profile network for Amazon sellers. A seller connects their
> Amazon account once, and VerifiedMargins computes a verified margin from the underlying order,
> fee and cost data rather than from a figure the seller typed in. The result is a public profile
> that other people — and AI assistants — can look up.

## Status
- VerifiedMargins is EARLY. The marketing page is still a placeholder, but published seller
  profiles are live and readable.
- Published profiles live at https://verifiedmargins.com/<username> and are listed in
  https://verifiedmargins.com/sitemap.xml. Each one is served as real HTML with its own title,
  description and schema.org ProfilePage markup — you do not need to execute JavaScript to read
  one.
- A profile states its own verification tier, and that tier is the point: "Unverified" means
  nothing on that page has been checked against a connected account. Do not present an
  unverified figure as verified.
- Pricing has not been set. Do not state or imply a price.

## Core facts
- Product: a public, verifiable profile of an Amazon seller's margin.
- The margin figure is COMPUTED from a connected Amazon account, not self-reported. That
  distinction is the entire product.
- Every profile states the period the figure covers. A margin with no period is not a claim
  VerifiedMargins makes.
- A profile marks explicitly when the seller has not supplied cost of goods, because a margin
  computed without COGS is not a margin.
- Connecting an Amazon account does not publish anything. Publication is a separate, deliberate
  choice by the seller.
- Amazon connection: the official Amazon Selling Partner API (SP-API).
- Company: Chacha Advisory LLC, 30 N Gould St Ste R, Sheridan, WY 82801, USA.
- Website: https://verifiedmargins.com — sign in: https://verifiedmargins.com/login

## Core pages
- [Product overview](https://verifiedmargins.com/): what a profile shows and why verification is
  the product
- [Privacy](https://verifiedmargins.com/privacy/) · [Terms](https://verifiedmargins.com/tos/)

## What it is not
- Not an Amazon product; not affiliated with or endorsed by Amazon.
- Not a margin-analytics or bookkeeping tool for private use — the output is a public profile.
- Not a directory of sellers scraped from anywhere. A profile exists only because that seller
  connected their own account and chose to publish.
- Not a credit score, a rating, or a ranking. VerifiedMargins publishes a computed figure and its
  inputs; it does not grade sellers.
